div.div:
Access boundaries
The LAN column is independent recovery, not a Tailscale Operator feature. A remote Talos/LAN route is still an open design. Access IdP is not selected; the Keycloak card represents application identity only. No WARP is required.

text.tspan: The LAN column is independent recovery, not a Tailscale Operator feature. A remote Talos/LAN route is still an open design. Access IdP is not selected; the Keycloak card represents
application identity only. No WARP is required.

div.div:
Publication and authorization
This view follows private web access. Explicit public web routes are a separate allowlist decision and retain application auth. Management APIs and datastores have no public Tunnel route. Selected private services need their own tailnet restrictions; this view shows the Kubernetes API path.

text.tspan: This view follows private web access. Explicit public web routes are a separate allowlist decision and retain application auth. Management APIs and datastores have no public Tunnel
route. Selected private services need their own tailnet restrictions; this view shows the Kubernetes API path.

div.div:
Origin and recovery gates
Validate Access tokens at cloudflared or the origin; preserve Host/SNI and TLS verification. Review forwarded headers and admin CIDR trust. Recovery credentials and LAN procedures must work without connectors or in-cluster identity.

text.tspan: Validate Access tokens at cloudflared or the origin; preserve Host/SNI and TLS verification. Review forwarded headers and admin CIDR trust. Recovery credentials and LAN procedures
must work without connectors or in-cluster identity.
